detail: Full summary: liveness controls caught three vacuous passes in oracle-derived tests — readable tenant names, post bodies missing entry_type, and human_ruling on a decision record all FAIL ADMISSION SILENTLY, so exclusion assertions passed against records never in the store. Rule for every lane: assert the seed projected before scoring an exclusion.
